description: Source code for DHCPv4 client status API functions, including system info retrieval and DHCP state management, with functions interfacing with system commands and files.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_up_time
methods.description: Retrieves system uptime in seconds by reading /proc/uptime.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_lease_time
methods.description: Gets the E-Router offered DHCP lease time via system command.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_remain_lease_time
methods.description: Calculates remaining lease time based on system uptime and start time.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_remain_renew_time
methods.description: Calculates remaining renewal time based on lease and start times.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_remain_rebind_time
methods.description: Calculates remaining rebind time based on lease and start times.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_config_attempts
methods.description: Returns a fixed number of configuration attempts (100).

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_ifname
methods.description: Retrieves the current WAN interface name via system command.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_fsm_state
methods.description: Returns DHCP client state, defaulting to 'bound' (5).

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_ip_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the erouter interface via system command.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_mask
methods.description: Retrieves subnet mask, converts to bitmask, and returns in network byte order.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_gw
methods.description: Retrieves default gateway IP address via system command.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_dns_svrs
methods.description: Retrieves list of DNS server IPs via system commands, up to 4 servers.

methods.name: dhcpv4c_get_ert_dhcp_svr
methods.description: Retrieves DHCP server IP address via system command.
